title: pvNetworkImageSource
body:
## pvNetworkImageSource

ParaView-internal source that reads an image file on one process and makes the image available on the client and render-server processes, used for textures and background images. In ReadFromMemory mode it instead fetches an image registered under TrivialProducerKey on the server. It is not a general network download. To read image data for analysis use readImageData or a pv image reader such as pvPNGSeriesReader.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- FileName is required by the Schemaxis binding even in ReadFromMemory mode.
- Schemaxis serial examples do not establish MPI or client-server behaviour. Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `NetworkImageSource`. Identity: `sources/NetworkImageSource`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileName` | Set the name of image file to load. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `Mode` | Set the mode in which image data is read. | `{"type":"enum","values":["ReadFromFile","ReadFromMemory"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"ReadFromFile"` |
| `TrivialProducerKey` | Set the key used to locate the image data object on the server. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvNetworkImageSource",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
